configuration.status: exploratory comparison on previously examined history/current-survivor candidate universe
configuration.hypothesis: explicit heterogeneous unique variances may estimate shared factors better than PCA; whether the resulting residuals reverse is a separate test
configuration.universe: same expanded200 candidates and daily admission: 272 complete prior contiguous log returns, no future availability filter
configuration.fit: 120 prior observations ending t-1; stockwise intercept+SPY fit; demean/standardize residuals with sample SD floor0.0001
configuration.PCA: top3 right singular vectors of the standardized residual matrix
configuration.EFA: sklearn FactorAnalysis, three factors, lapack SVD, no rotation, tol0.001, max_iter1000, default all-ones unique variance initialization, no warm start or outcome-based model selection
configuration.raw_exposures: residual_sigma[:,None] times PCA vectors or EFA loading matrix; add ones and past SPY beta; rank5
configuration.signal: same one-day vendor-adjusted close-close log return at t
configuration.portfolio: same cross-sectional WLS and holdings -W*residual / sum(abs(W*residual)); W=inverse prior total-return variance, sigma floor0.0001; no caps
configuration.not_changed: do not replace portfolio W by EFA unique variances or use posterior factor scores as a different trading signal
configuration.execution: next vendor raw daily-bar open to same-day raw close, ideal fractional dollars, unit gross, flat nightly, no gate
configuration.primary: paired EFA3 minus PCA3 daily gross mean, 1000 circular60-day bootstrap, approximate95 interval separately per period
configuration.horizon_secondary: same common complete20 dates as previous study; frozen initial sleeves, cumulative all-adjusted next-open to 1/5/20-close; mean profit and e'W R/e'W e response slope
configuration.structural_secondary: every20 formation dates with complete next20 returns and no split crossing; future WLS residual mean absolute pair correlation using past-fixed exposures/W, and raw loading-subspace overlap with previous diagnostic block on common stocks
configuration.structure_interpretation: future common-return coefficients are ex-post decompositions only, never used in trading; raw subspace overlap = ||Qprev'Qcurrent||F^2/3, rotation-invariant, not economic-factor identification
configuration.uncertainty_secondary: 60-day blocks for overlapping daily horizon events; three diagnostic-block draws for structural summaries; simultaneous two-metric structural bands, three-horizon bands separately for event means/slopes; no correction across project history
configuration.periods: entry before2024 development, otherwise later; later already examined, not untouched holdout
configuration.checks: full saved PCA holdings/returns/events reconciliation; EFA convergence/likelihood/uniqueness logs; rotation/column-scale invariance; independent WLS and EM likelihood audit
